clarification: A first 2022 occurrence permits only a strongly shrunk phase-matched contribution in 2023. It does not establish persistent seasonality.

causal_accumulation.2023_freeze: may use the adjudicated homologous 2022 phase only
causal_accumulation.2024_freeze: may use adjudicated homologous phases from 2022 and 2023
causal_accumulation.persistence_adjudication: uses the complete 2022->2023->2024 causal chain, including the existing 2024 monthly evidence, and reports phase direction/stability separately by target and hierarchy

bridged_2023_seasonality_diagnostic.purpose: After 2022 closes, test the specific seasonal model against 2023 using the two surrounding year-phase observations: 2022 and the already sealed 2024 evidence.
bridged_2023_seasonality_diagnostic.permitted_use: Quantify whether 2023 aligns with the phase-specific signal shared by 2022 and 2024, separately for participation, quantity and statistical unit value.

prohibited_interpretation: No claim of real persistent seasonality may be made from 2022 alone or from a pooled retrospective fit.
